svg.title: Video Template H BPM workflow — AI Avatar
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for AI Avatar. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Shared skeleton plus S1–S4 scale overlays; the source maps H but does not define a bespoke ordered graph. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.text: Video Template H · AI Avatar BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Create a consented synthetic presenter workflow with governed
identity, voice, lip-sync and disclosure. Avatar explainers,
talking-head campaigns, personalized presenters and multilingual
S1–S4 scale overlays; the source maps H but does not define a
L1 required; consent and disclosure hard gates; identity, voice,
lip-sync and deepfake review scale with risk.
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Define presenter purpose, audience and channels.
• Choose scale from duration, languages and risk.
• Block missing consent or deceptive use.
• Freeze allowed identity and language scope.
Revise use case, identity or consent.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Design synthetic identity and visual rules.
• Write script, pronunciation and localization plan.
• Select approved voice and template treatment.
• L1 validates script, identity bank and consent.
• Lock reference frames and voice profile.
Avatar bank · script · voice profile · consent chain
Fix identity, script or language defect.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Run identity consistency and artifact QA.
• No unapproved identity or voice substitution.
Avatar takes · voice · sync report · telemetry
Rerender failed face, voice or sync segment.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Add captions, sign language or localization.
• Create channel-specific aspect and duration variants.
• Check disclosure, readability and language quality.
• Preserve identity provenance in every variant.
Fix accessibility, language or graphics issue.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Escalate identity or high-risk claims to HiTL.
• Consent is a hard gate at every scale.
• Higher scales add strict L2 and rights review.
Return identity, disclosure or claim issue.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Package marketing, social, CRM or LMS variants.
• Keep language and identity metadata aligned.
• Each outlet and language is independently ready.
Channel packages · disclosure metadata · archive copy
Repackage failed language or channel only.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Measure clarity, completion and trust signals.
• Improve reference banks through tested tickets.
• Private or biometric data is not reused silently.
Quality report · correction log · improvement tickets
Feed validated improvements into future avatars.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Shared skeleton plus S1–S4 scale overlays; the source maps H but does not define a bespoke ordered graph.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 34 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
